glance: Saturday evening will mark the 14th meeting between Notre Dame and SMU. The series stands with a 10-3-0 Notre Dame advantage all-time.
Saturday night against SMU will be Notre Dame's 2026 senior night.
The Irish are 6-1-0 all-time in home games against the Mustangs.
The first meeting between Notre Dame and SMU inside Notre Dame Stadium came in 1930, when the Irish defeated the Mustangs 20-14.
It is the first meeting between SMU and Notre Dame since the Mustangs joined the ACC in 2024.
The Irish claimed a 59-6 win inside Notre Dame Stadium over the Mustangs 1989. The Irish were the number one team in the nation at the time.

Takeaways through 10 games, with 10 interceptions and 10 fumble recoveries.

Consecutive home wins over ACC opponents, a program record.
Consecutive games with a reception for Jordan Faison, who extended the streak with a four-yard catch on Notre Dame’s first offensive play against Boston College.
